from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path.cwd()
SOURCE_ROOTS = (ROOT / "src", ROOT / "scripts")
MARKER = re.compile(r"\b(?:TODO|FIXME|XXX|HACK)\b", re.IGNORECASE)


def mutable_default(node: ast.expr | None) -> bool:
    return isinstance(node, (ast.List, ast.Dict, ast.Set))


findings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
for source_root in SOURCE_ROOTS:
    for path in sorted(source_root.rglob("*.py")):
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for line_number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            if MARKER.search(line):
                findings.append(
                    {
                        "kind": "unfinished_marker",
                        "path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        "line": line_number,
                        "text": line.strip(),
                    }
                )
        tree = ast.parse(text, filename=str(path))
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.ExceptHandler) and node.type is None:
                findings.append(
                    {
                        "kind": "bare_except",
                        "path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        "line": node.lineno,
                    }
                )
            if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                defaults = [*node.args.defaults, *node.args.kw_defaults]
                for default in defaults:
                    if mutable_default(default):
                        findings.append(
                            {
                                "kind": "mutable_default",
                                "path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                                "line": node.lineno,
                                "function": node.name,
                            }
                        )
report = {
    "schema": "aspenops.comprehensive-hygiene/v3",
    "findings": findings,
    "decision": "PASS" if not findings else "FAIL",
}
output = ROOT / "var/comprehensive-closure-v3/hygiene.json"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
if findings:
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))
